chunks: Sa'd narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Faddal, from 'Abd Allah ibn Bukayr, from some of our companions, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:

About a man leading a woman in prayer, he said: Yes, she stands behind him. And about a woman leading women in prayer, he said: Yes, she stands in the middle among them and does not stand ahead of them.

key_terms.النِّسَاءَ: the women being led in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.تَتَقَدَّمُهُنَّ: go ahead of them or stand in front of them
key_terms.خَلْفَهُ: behind him, describing the woman's position in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.وَسَطًا: in the middle, indicating the female leader's position among the women

ai.seo_question: Can a woman lead other women in salat (prayer), and where should she stand?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling that when a man leads a woman in salat (prayer), she stands behind him. It also states that when a woman leads other women in salat (prayer), she stands in the middle of them rather than in front.
